# Health and Performance Requirements Checklist: Multi-Format Books

**Purpose**: Validate that derived publication health, integrity handling, fallback, and reproducible performance evidence are complete, unambiguous, measurable, and ready for task regeneration.
**Created**: 2026-07-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all inputs to the healthy-variant definition documented, including active metadata, binary reference, detected format, byte accessibility, declared size, SHA-256 identity, and quarantine status? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §Derived Variant Availability]
- [x] CHK002 Are all derived availability statuses and required causes defined with distinct meanings and consequences: `checking`, `healthy`, `unavailable` with its four causes, and `quarantined` with its three causes? [Completeness, Data Model §Derived Variant Availability, Domain Contract §Error Contract]
- [x] CHK003 Are authoritative health-evaluation boundaries fully enumerated for ingestion, restore or download, exact-source replacement, and opening a publication source? [Completeness, Plan §Security and Failure Handling, Research §Decision 12]
- [x] CHK004 Is the exclusion of catalog cover state from publication health explicit everywhere health inputs are described? [Completeness, Data Model §Derived Variant Availability, Plan §Security and Failure Handling]
- [x] CHK005 Are the required environment dimensions documented for every primary performance profile, including CPU, memory, power mode, OS or kernel, runtime, viewport, fixture identity, and emulator snapshot where applicable? [Completeness, Performance Contract §Versioned Profile Set]
- [x] CHK006 Is the closed 14-branch acknowledgement matrix complete and identical across the specification, performance contract, quickstart, and tasks? [Coverage, Spec §Lifecycle and performance, Performance Contract §Closed Acknowledgement Matrix, Quickstart §6]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the distinction between a lightweight `checking` result and an authoritative `healthy` result unambiguous about which evidence each may assert? [Clarity, Plan §Contracts and State, Data Model §Derived Variant Availability]
- [x] CHK008 Are eligibility status and explanation cause distinguished objectively, including the rule that isolated invalid data returns `quarantined` with an integrity-invalid, unsupported, or malformed-reference cause? [Clarity, Data Model §Derived Variant Availability, Domain Contract §Logical Read Operations]
- [x] CHK009 Is the rule that a valid replacement active source supersedes historical quarantine evidence precise about which record is authoritative? [Clarity, Plan §Contracts and State, Research §Decision 12]
- [x] CHK010 Are the start and end boundaries for `acknowledgementMs` and `finalResultMs` defined separately for each action class, including the required painted-state boundary? [Clarity, Performance Contract §Measurement Boundaries]
- [x] CHK011 Is it explicit that a visible busy or progress state may satisfy acknowledgement but never the final-result boundary? [Clarity, Plan §Lifecycle and Performance, Performance Contract §Measurement Boundaries]
- [x] CHK012 Are `PASS`, `FAIL`, `UNVERIFIED`, and `SUPPLEMENTAL` defined so that environment mismatch, unavailable hardware, and faster hardware cannot be interpreted inconsistently? [Clarity, Performance Contract §Versioned Profile Set and §Environment Preflight and Results]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Is device-local derived health consistently excluded from durable records, backup manifests, and synchronization documents? [Consistency, Data Model §Derived Variant Availability, Backup Contract §Manifest Shape, Sync Contract §Safe Provider Layout]
- [x] CHK014 Is the no-eager-hashing library rule consistent with the requirement that only exact verified bytes may be classified as healthy? [Consistency, Plan §Security and Failure Handling, Research §Decision 12]
- [x] CHK015 Are fallback ordering and preference rules consistent when the preferred variant is unhealthy, including retention of the synchronized preference and no preference update after fallback or failure? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases and §FR-021, Data Model §Logical Book Format Preference]
- [x] CHK016 Are the four profile identifiers and their frozen environment definitions consistent across the plan, quickstart, and performance contract? [Consistency, Plan §Lifecycle and Performance, Quickstart §6, Performance Contract §Versioned Profile Set]
- [x] CHK017 Is the all-samples one-second acknowledgement threshold clearly distinct from the per-distribution p95 and 95%-within-two-seconds final-result thresholds? [Consistency, Spec §SC-004, Performance Contract §Dataset and Thresholds]
- [x] CHK018 Is the requirement to keep actions, formats, switch directions, profiles, warm-ups, and measured samples separate consistent across all performance artifacts? [Consistency, Plan §Lifecycle and Performance, Quickstart §6, Performance Contract §Dataset and Thresholds]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 Can same-size corrupt bytes and declared-versus-detected format mismatches be objectively classified and tied to an explicit isolation outcome? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006 and §Edge Cases, Research §Decision 12]
- [x] CHK020 Can recovery from unavailable or quarantined status be objectively determined without changing logical-book membership or exact variant identity? [Measurability, Data Model §Unavailable or quarantined variant, Plan §Contracts and State]
- [x] CHK021 Can first-painted semantic acknowledgement be measured from one page-side monotonic time origin without allowing diagnostic runner timing to establish acceptance? [Measurability, Performance Contract §Measurement Boundaries]
- [x] CHK022 Are warm-up counts, minimum measured sample counts, acknowledgement branch counts, denominators, and non-pooling rules sufficient to yield one reproducible pass decision? [Measurability, Performance Contract §Dataset and Thresholds]
- [x] CHK023 Does SC-004 unambiguously require all four primary profiles to report `PASS`, with any `FAIL` or `UNVERIFIED` profile blocking acceptance? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004, Performance Contract §Environment Preflight and Results]
- [x] CHK024 Are zero-tolerance conditions for wrong publication or format, missing acknowledgement, console error, and overlapping reader engines stated as acceptance criteria rather than diagnostics? [Acceptance Criteria, Performance Contract §Dataset and Thresholds]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for every unavailable/quarantine cause, historical quarantine, local exact-source replacement, descriptor-gated synchronized retry, cancellation, mismatch, and successful recovery? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases and §FR-019, Plan §Security and Failure Handling]
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements complete for an unhealthy preferred variant, one healthy sibling, and no healthy variants, including visibility, explanation, fallback, recovery, and management consequences? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3 and §Edge Cases, Domain Contract §Reader Contract]
- [x] CHK027 Are profile-drift scenarios covered for CPU or memory limits, OS or runtime versions, power state, viewport, dataset hashes, dirty working state, and emulator snapshot identity? [Coverage, Performance Contract §Environment Preflight and Results]
- [x] CHK028 Is the evidence disposition defined when a primary host, emulator, packaged runtime, or exact browser or WebView version is unavailable? [Coverage, Plan §Lifecycle and Performance, Performance Contract §Versioned Profile Set]

## Dependencies and Traceability

- [x] CHK029 Are ownership, immutability, versioning, result location, and result-schema requirements defined for `performance/profiles-v1.json` and raw evidence files? [Dependency, Plan §Repository Paths, Performance Contract §Versioned Profile Set and §Environment Preflight and Results]
- [x] CHK030 Is source-health authority assigned to domain and persistence boundaries while publication engines remain consumers only of validated sources? [Dependency, Constitution §III, Plan §Impact and Ownership, Research §Decision 12]
